MongoDB's docs use "independent CRD" narrowly: a resource is independent when it is associated with its Atlas project directly by Atlas project ID (`externalProjectRef`) rather than through an `AtlasProject` Kubernetes object. Separately, beginning with AKO 2.6, various `AtlasProject` parameter configurations moved into CRDs of their own, which the docs title "Migrate Parameters to Custom Resource Definitions". A standalone CRD can still be used in project-managed mode through `projectRef`: `AtlasIPAccessList` has both `projectRef` and `externalProjectRef`, which are mutually exclusive. Source

In the independent CRD model, AKO manages resources in an Atlas project without managing the project itself, and resources are associated with the project by Atlas project ID. AKO 2.5.0 first made `AtlasDeployment` and `AtlasDatabaseUser` usable as independent resources. The external reference type is `ExternalProjectReference` with a single required field `id`. `AtlasDatabaseUser` specs embed `ProjectDualReference` inline. One CEL rule requires exactly one of `projectRef` or `externalProjectRef`, with message "must define only one project reference through externalProjectRef or projectRef". The CRDs carry two CEL rules. Rule 1: `(has(self.externalProjectRef) && !has(self.projectRef)) || (!has(self.externalProjectRef) && has(self.projectRef))`, with message "must define only one project reference through externalProjectRef or projectRef". Rule 2: `(has(self.externalProjectRef) && has(self.connectionSecret)) || !has(self.externalProjectRef)`, with message "must define a local connection secret when referencing an external project".
